title: Legends' El Clásico Comes to Kolkata: Barcelona and Real Madrid Greats Set for November 25 at Salt Lake Stadium
excerpt: West Bengal sports minister Indranil Khan announced the exhibition on Tuesday. Luís Figo, Iker Casillas and Carles Puyol are reported as potential attractions, though final squads, kick-off time and ticket details are yet to be confirmed.
body:
• Barcelona Legends will face Real Madrid Legends in an exhibition match at Kolkata's Vivekananda Yuva Bharati Krirangan (Salt Lake Stadium) on November 25, 2026.
  • West Bengal sports minister Indranil Khan announced the fixture on Tuesday, posting "El Clásico Loading.." on his official X handle.
  • Luís Figo, Iker Casillas and Carles Puyol have been reported as potential participants; final squads have not been officially confirmed, and kick-off time, ticket sales and broadcast details are awaited.
  • The last Legends' El Clásico in India was played on April 6, 2025 at Navi Mumbai's DY Patil Stadium, where Real Madrid Leyendas beat Barcelona 2-0 with goals from Fernando Morientes and David Barral.

Kolkata's football calendar has added its most glamorous date yet. Barcelona Legends and Real Madrid Legends will meet in an exhibition El Clásico at the Vivekananda Yuva Bharati Krirangan — Salt Lake Stadium — on November 25, West Bengal sports minister Indranil Khan announced on Tuesday, teasing the fixture on X with the message "El Clásico Loading.."

What is known, and what is not

The match will feature retired players of the two Spanish giants rather than current first-team squads. Reports name Luís Figo — who famously played for both clubs — Iker Casillas and Carles Puyol as potential attractions, but the final squads have not been officially confirmed, and details of kick-off time, ticket sales and broadcast arrangements are still awaited. Readers should treat any roster circulating before an official announcement as provisional: legends fixtures are assembled player by player, and line-ups have changed late in previous editions.

Kolkata's year of football

The fixture lands in a city already deep into a remarkable football season. Salt Lake Stadium hosted the Indian men's national team against five-time world champions Brazil on October 3 and two-time champions Uruguay on October 6 — Brazil won the first-ever meeting 4-0 — giving Kolkata's supporters a run of world football few Indian cities have matched. The Legends' Clásico follows a proven Indian template: the previous edition, at Navi Mumbai's DY Patil Stadium on April 6, 2025, drew a large crowd to watch Real Madrid Leyendas beat Barcelona 2-0, with Fernando Morientes and David Barral scoring and Figo, Michael Owen, Pepe, Xavi Hernández, Rivaldo and Puyol among those involved. If Kolkata's edition assembles a comparable cast, November 25 will be less a football match than a reunion of the generation that made El Clásico a global television ritual — staged in the Indian city that never needed convincing.
